findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: golemreach_cast · Private data: golemreach_guild, golemreach_connect, golemreach_look, golemreach_move, golemreach_attack, golemreach_cast, golemreach_use, golemreach_inventory, golemreach_talk, golemreach_trade, golemreach_where, golemreach_wait, golemreach_invite_administrator · Public sink: golemreach_cast, golemreach_where, golemreach_invite_administrator · Destructive: golemreach_look, golemreach_attack, golemreach_use, golemreach_where, golemreach_wait.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: golemreach_cast · Private data: golemreach_guild, golemreach_connect, golemreach_look, golemreach_move, golemreach_attack, golemreach_cast, golemreach_use, golemreach_inventory, golemreach_talk, golemreach_trade, golemreach_where, golemreach_wait, golemreach_invite_administrator · Public sink: golemreach_cast, golemreach_where, golemreach_invite_administrator · Destructive: golemreach_look, golemreach_attack, golemreach_use, golemreach_where, golemreach_wait

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
